title: General Cognitive Ability or Task-Specific Structure? Cross-Task Covariance and Trial-Level Decision Analysis in Honey Bee Learning
summary: Rerun (local ARIS, 2026-09-26) quantitative reanalysis: published-summary covariance structure among honey-bee learning tasks (M1-M5) plus trial-level mixed-model decision analysis on Oxman et al. 2026 (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.17771502). Result: hierarchical task-specific structure rather than single-factor GCA (M1 partial support, RL2-NP edge borderline under LOO); robust information tracking (focal circuit rate, beta=0.0106, p<.001) and robust dancer-personality effect (liar followers +26% time, p=2.5e-05); latent-precision proxy exploratory only. Claims policy enforced: no GCA claim, uncertainty-monitoring claims require independent chains, neural inferences flagged hypothetical.
